messages.content: I'm planning a series of long weekend getaways for the upcoming year and I need to know when they'll occur in my country. Could you fetch me the list of long weekends for Canada in the year 2023? I'd like to integrate this information into my holiday planning app.

message.content:
Below is a **complete list of the long‑weekend holidays that apply to the entire country of Canada in 2023** (i.e., federal holidays that fall on a weekday or are observed on a weekday, creating a three‑day weekend).  
For holidays that are province‑specific (e.g., Family Day, St. Patricks’ Day, etc.) I’ve added a note indicating the provinces where the holiday is observed.  

| Date Range (2023) | Holiday | Day(s) Covered | Province(s) (if applicable) |
|-------------------|---------|----------------|-----------------------------|
| **Jan 1–2** | New Year’s Day (observed Jan 2) | Sun–Mon | All of Canada |
| **Feb 20** (Mon) | Family Day (observed Mon) | Mon | Ontario, Alberta, Saskatchewan, New Brunswick, Manitoba, Prince Edward Island, Nova Scotia (Feb 20) |
| **Apr 7–9** | Good Friday (Fri) & Easter Saturday/Sunday | Fri–Sun | All of Canada |
| **May 20–22** | Victoria Day (Mon) | Sat–Mon | All of Canada |
| **Jul 1–3** | Canada Day (Sat) & observed Mon | Sat–Mon | All of Canada |
| **Sep 2–4** | Labour Day (Mon) | Sat–Mon | All of Canada |
| **Oct 7–9** | Thanksgiving (Mon) | Sat–Mon | All of Canada |
| **Nov 11–13** | Remembrance Day (Sat) & observed Mon | Sat–Mon | All of Canada |
| **Dec 23–25** | Christmas Day (Mon) | Sat–Mon | All of Canada |

### Quick Notes

* **Family Day** – The date varies by province; in 2023 it fell on **Feb 20** in most provinces (except Nova Scotia, where it was on **Feb 21**).  
* **St. Patrick’s Day** – Observed as a statutory holiday in **Ontario** (Mar 17, 2023) and **New Brunswick** (Mar 17, 2023). It does **not** create a long weekend because it falls on a Friday, but the following Saturday and Sunday are already weekend days.  
* **Boxing Day** (Dec 26) is a statutory holiday but does **not** create a long weekend in 2023 because it falls on a Tuesday.  

Feel free to plug this table into your holiday‑planning app. If you need province‑specific long weekends (e.g., for Quebec’s **Saint‑Jean‑Baptiste Day** on June 24, 2023), let me know!
